test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ravi took a loan from a bank at the rate of 8% p.a. simple interest. After 5 years, he had to pay an interest of Rs. 6,400 for the period. Find the principal amount borrowed by Ravi.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Rate = 8%

Time = 5 years

Simple Interest = 6400

**FORMULA USED:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

**SOLUTION:**

According to the given conditions;

SI = (P × R × T) / 100 by substituting values we get;

⇒ 6400 = (P × 8 × 5) / 100

⇒ 6400 × 100 = (P × 8 × 5)

⇒ P = (6400 × 100) / 8 × 5

⇒ P = 16000

Hence option 1 is the valid answer.
